name: Phut
overview: Phut, also called Put, is identified in Scripture as one of the sons of Ham, alongside Cush, Mizraim, and Canaan (Genesis 10:6; 1 Chronicles 1:8). The name Phut refers both to the individual ancestor and to the descendants or territory associated with them, commonly linked to the region of Libya (Jeremiah 46:9; Ezekiel 30:5; Ezekiel 38:5). These descendants are depicted as warriors equipped with shields and helmets, participating in armies alongside other nations such as Persia and Lydia (Ezekiel 27:10). This highlights the role of Phut’s lineage in the broader biblical narrative of nations and conflicts surrounding Israel.
